name: unlinked
description: Search your owner-scoped imported network and the complete published professional People index with an explicitly revocable account grant. Recovered Connections observations require the same confirmed owner; original files are browser-only and excluded from grants.

authentication.provisioning: Prepared automatically at the setup URL; owner can revoke or regenerate there. Repeated provisioning never mints duplicate grants.

tools.name: unlinked_search_network
tools.description: Search the owner's imported network, or pass degree 1/2 plus an optional cursor to read recorded public paths from the explicitly confirmed recovered profile.
